title: Ada Lovelace's Note G and the First Published Algorithm (1843)
explainer: In 1843, Ada Lovelace published 'Note G,' a set of step-by-step instructions for calculating Bernoulli numbers on Charles Babbage's never-built Analytical Engine — work historians generally regard as the first published computer algorithm. Her notes work by repeating a cycle of operations and updating variables each time through, the same basic shape as the for and while loops in this lesson, worked out a century before any machine existed that could actually run them.
